description: This file defines the class InAccessibleEntityIdOption, which encapsulates validation rules for access control, including exception message handling, permission and role restrictions, and throw behavior.

classes.name: InAccessibleEntityIdOption
classes.description: A class that manages validation options related to entity accessibility, permission requirements, roles to include or exclude, and exception handling.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the ValidationEscapableException instance, initializing it as a ForbiddenException with the current message if not set.

methods.name: setThrowable
methods.description: Sets the throwable exception object used for validation errors.

methods.name: getExceptionMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the current exception message string.

methods.name: setExceptionMessage
methods.description: Sets the exception message to be used for validation errors.

methods.name: isThrow
methods.description: Indicates whether to throw an exception upon validation failure.

methods.name: setThrow
methods.description: Configures whether to throw an exception when validation fails.

methods.name: isThrowIfOnlyEntityExist
methods.description: Indicates whether to throw an exception if only the entity exists.

methods.name: setThrowIfOnlyEntityExist
methods.description: Configures the behavior of throwing an exception if only the entity exists.

methods.name: getRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Returns the array of required permissions for validation.

methods.name: setRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Sets the list of permissions required for access validation.

methods.name: getRolesToExclude
methods.description: Returns roles to be excluded from validation.

methods.name: setRolesToExclude
methods.description: Defines roles to be excluded from access validation.

methods.name: getRolesToInclude
methods.description: Returns roles to be included for validation.

methods.name: setRolesToInclude
methods.description: Defines roles to be included for validation.
